findings.finding: Cloud Run source contracts exist, but deployment, IAM reachability, scheduler execution, secret versions and off-laptop operation were not observed.

findings.control: Keep zero approvals and label the run incomplete; continue with query-level receipts and full finalist fields before claiming OMEGA IX completion.
